hook: A full step-sequencer studio in one file: 214 sounds and 10 drum kits, 30 instruments, your own samples, a piano roll, a song playlist and a mixer with sidechain pump and a DJ filter. Export your track as a WAV.
outcome: Compose, arrange and produce an original track: build rhythms and harmony in a key, develop ideas through variation and song form, and refine a mix before presenting the finished work
sources: All sound synthesized in the browser with the Web Audio API
Demo tracks written for Curio Class
